# dewey

> Keeps docs usable by people and coding agents, and checks they still match the code

## What it does

- Writes AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, llms.txt and a static docs site from one folder of Markdown
- Checks maps, reviews, references, links and outputs against the code
- React components for rendering docs in an existing site
- Prompt templates for reviewing and improving docs

## Installation

bun add -d @deweydocs/dewey

## CLI

dewey init                 - Set up front door, skills, drafts and .dewey/project.json
dewey build                - Build .dewey/site, llms.txt and llms-full.txt
dewey check [--json]       - Fail on drafts, stale reviews, broken references, stale outputs
dewey review <doc>         - Record that a covered doc was reviewed
dewey new <kind> <name>    - Draft a map, guide, reference or history doc
dewey which <path>         - List docs that cover a path
dewey uncovered            - List source files no map covers

Frozen (warn, will be removed): audit, generate, agent, create, update, eject

## Key Concepts

1. Kinds of doc
   - guide and reference: published on the site
   - map: covers source files, read by agents, not published
   - history: plans and decisions, not published

2. Skills System
   - Skills are LLM prompts, not code
   - Built-in: docsReviewAgent, promptSlideoutGenerator, installMdGenerator, docsDesignCritic, improveAIPrompts

3. install.md Standard
   - Follows installmd.org specification
   - Agent-ready: `curl -fsSL url/install.md`, then supply the returned instructions to an AI agent
